data.body: [P1] Register outcome observation before dispatching the handler. With an inline executor, submit-and-wait executor, or sufficiently fast worker, suspension/termination and the handler's subsequent `finally` can both finish before this call. `runUntilCompleteOrSuspend` then sees both futures completed and selects the handler future first, allowing a cleanup return or exception to replace PENDING/RETRYING with SUCCEEDED/FAILED and prevent replay. Restore the pre-created handler future and register the manager outcome before scheduling. Reinstate the removed `naturalManagerOutcomePrecedesFastThrowingFinally` regression coverage.
